auth.panelTitle: Order stock fast. Run your whole dukan from one app.
auth.panelPoint1: Order from distributors in minutes, with clear margins and schemes.
auth.panelPoint2: Billing, stock and khata that work even without internet.
auth.panelPoint3: Ask Munshi in Urdu, Roman Urdu or English.
auth.panelFooter: Made for the dukans of Hyderabad.
